text:
Zoe: Customer report — refund did not go through; autorouter invoked payout tool instead. They say payload had amount but currency was empty. Repro steps attached. Can we triage? @Alan @Anya

Zoe: payload:
```
{
  "customer_id": "cus_123",
  "amount": 4500,
  "currency": "",
  "reason": "order_cancellation",
  "metadata": {"order_id":"ord_987"}
}
```

Zoe: request_id: req_2026-03-17-7751

Alan: looking into it :eyes:

Alan: quick log from autorouter:
```
INFO tool_selector: request=req_2026-03-17-7751 input_summary="amount present, currency missing" selected_tool="issue_payout" score=0.62 rule=fallback_legacy
```

Alan: that rule is legacy behavior — if currency missing and amount > 0 it prefers payout path (historical). Not great for refunds.

Anya: ack. we should require currency in schema validation for any finance tool. interim: bump refund tool priority when `reason` contains "refund"/"cancellation".

Zoe: customer also included human note: "I asked for a refund, got a payout to a different account." They want repro + mitigation asap.

SRE-Oncall: severity: user-visible money flow; escalate. Can we hotfix routing heuristics? :fire:

Alan: plan: 1) add validation to return 400 with message "missing currency" for finance endpoints; 2) change selector to favor `create_refund` when `reason` includes refund-like tokens; 3) add unit test for empty currency.

Anya: I'll draft PR for selector change. Alan — can you add the schema check and tests? I'll handle selector weights.

Alan: will do. create ticket and link PRs.

Zoe: created ticket #SUP-3127 with repro steps and payload, assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime.

DeployBot: staging deploy of selector-weight-change started for group `autorouter`.

DeployBot: staging deploy successful — run smoke tests.

Anya: smoke passed. Also added a regression test that reproduces payout selection when currency blank; now it picks `create_refund`.

Zoe: looping in support — update customer with ETA 3 hours, rolling fix to prod after validation is green.

SRE-Oncall: monitor payments queue for any further misroutes, alert on any refund-not-created events.

Alan: will push validation hotfix to prod after CI. ETA ~2h.

Zoe: thanks team. I'll update ticket and post a short FAQ for support about this edge case.
